title: Fix the demo replay check failing on an old build label
tier_reason: A failed build on main blocks every release and is safe to repair without a product ruling.
ask: CI run 35665001793 fails Demo replay is not stale because regeneration changes only the replay header build_id. The same failure predates the Codex integration. Reproduce the generation/check in .github/workflows/tests.yml; make the recorded fixture and freshness check deterministic without dropping meaningful replay validation. Preserve unrelated dirty assets/demo/demo_replay.json work.
first_action: Inspect the failed CI job at https://github.com/craklyn/tiny-farm-godot/actions/runs/35665001793, the demo generation command in .github/workflows/tests.yml, and how its header build_id is chosen. Fix in an isolated worktree and show repeat generation produces no diff.
source_message: Discovered while verifying the authorized HQ provider-routing work; recorded separately because the failure predates that work.
result: The committed development build identity is now the stable value `dev`, while tablet and release builds still stamp their real Git or tag identity immediately before regenerating the shipped replay. Generating the demo twice is byte-identical. The same change connects the CI poller to Engineering's work queue: one failed run creates one urgent repair owned by the VP of Engineering, and repeat polls cannot duplicate or reopen it.

landed.note: The replay check is deterministic and failed main runs now file one urgent Engineering repair automatically.

hq.summary: All HQ Python checks passed; CI intake regression added
